about_the_game:
🎨 DESIGN YOUR DREAM SPACES

Unleash your inner interior designer! Start with your own dream home, then take on decorating jobs across a vibrant city. From cozy apartments to stylish villas and scenic retreats, every project is a relaxing, pressure-free creative outlet.

🐾 MEET YOUR FELINE CRITIC

You're not designing alone! A witty, talking cat acts as your companion and toughest critic, offering purr-fectly honest feedback as you work. The real challenge? Balancing client requests with the high standards of your furry friend.

🤝 TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS

Invite friends or family to join the fun! Collaborate on projects, share ideas, or divide and conquer—one person can tackle the kitchen while another perfects the patio. It's a laid-back co-op experience all about creative expression, with no timers or scores to worry about.

🏰 GO BEYOND THE EVERYDAY

Your design journey isn't limited to houses. Get ready for unique creative gigs in castles, train cars, museums, and other unexpected locations. Each new project brings its own distinct style and story.

🗺️ EXPLORE THE WORLD

Expand your business as you unlock new regions and connect with clients from different cultures. Discover unique furniture, collect rare items, and build a design portfolio that's recognized around the globe.

P.S.
Decor Quest is where the zen of home design meets the joy of co-op creativity. It's your cozy digital dollhouse—ready to be built and shared with friends.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1+ or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: SSE2 compatible instruction set
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 8600 GS, ATI Radeon HD 3470
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c Compatible Sound Card with Latest Drivers
  • Additional Notes: Minimum 1280x720 screen resolution

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
